title: PC-CROP Federal Accounting — 1C extension outbound transport source
purpose: Add the first real 1C-side source slice on top of the server protocol and scoped machine-identity contracts: outbound-only HTTPS transport, bounded self-discovery, one-time pairing, heartbeat, pull-jobs, ACK/result/fail calls, strict no-redirect/no-arbitrary-host/header behavior, exact typed-command dispatch and a fail-closed configuration-adapter seam. This is source for a 1C extension, not a claim that a compiled .cfe has passed a real customer configuration yet.
boundaries: 1C initiates outbound HTTPS; there is no inbound listener, remote desktop or OData exposure.
The production host is compile-time pinned to the platform domain in this reference source; the bearer is never sent to an arbitrary URL supplied by data/user/job.
TLS validates the server through the operating-system CA store; plain HTTP is not representable by this module.
3xx redirects are refused so an authorization bearer cannot be redirected to another host.
Correlation and bearer header values use bounded safe alphabets; CR/LF/space/header injection is refused before HTTP request creation.

The machine bearer is accepted by the transport function as an already-protected secret; persistence is delegated to a configuration-specific secure-secret provider and is not implemented as plaintext storage here.
No bearer, pairing code, provider body or business document payload is written to the registration log by this source.
Self-discovery never sends a 1C connection string. Platform version is read from SystemInformation; configuration-specific version/legal-entity data must come from an accepted compatibility adapter.
Only the seven protocol commands are dispatchable; unknown commands fail closed and arbitrary SQL/code/database-dump operations are not represented.

Configuration-specific document creation/discovery remain fail-closed until a compatibility adapter implements them; the reference adapter returns UNKNOWN_RESULT/not-ready and does not pretend BP/KFH/ERP mappings are already accepted.
No compiled CFE, 1C:Fresh publication, 1C:Compatible certification, live customer database, production traffic or vendor claim.
Merge and green CI are not production acceptance.
requiredInvariants: All connector API calls are the exact /connector/v1 base or a slash-delimited child path on one pinned HTTPS host.
Authorization bearer is attached only after host/path, correlation-id and bearer-value security gates pass.
Redirect status is refused and never followed.
Unsafe job identifiers are refused instead of interpolated into a URL.
Pairing uses a one-time human code plus a validated discovery payload; later calls use machine bearer only.

Discovery contains exactly platform/configuration versions, opaque database instance id, explicit legal entities, exact command capabilities, connector version and protocol version; no connection string or secret.
A database exposing multiple legal entities must enumerate them explicitly and duplicate GUIDs are refused.
Every job carries idempotency/correlation/revision/attempt and is ACKed before execution.
Unknown command and not-yet-implemented configuration adapter result in fail/unknown, never success.
REPORTED_SUCCESS requires the configuration adapter to return its own external evidence id; transport success alone is never reported as business success.
